balanceScope: Active new story-song series; preserve the existing library unless the user requests new editions.

styles.name: 空灵叮咚流行
styles.sound: Airy and spacious; delicate bell-like or glassy plucked motifs, soft piano and acoustic colour, light pulse and a clear close adult voice. The user's sensory description governs; this is not a mandatory folk-pop label.

styles.name: 孟菲斯 Hip-hop
styles.sound: Bright bouncy Memphis-inspired groove, rounded deep 808s, dry snare/claps, playful triplet hi-hats, acoustic plucks, sparse cowbell and clear melodic rap with a sung hook.

styles.name: 原声 Folk-pop
styles.sound: Guitar-led, grounded and conversational, with acoustic bass and restrained percussion.

styles.name: 温暖 Soul-pop
styles.sound: Rhodes or piano, warm bass and a gentle pocket, with expressive clear vocals.

styles.name: 电子 Art-pop
styles.sound: Spacious synth layers and evolving pulses support observations, tests and a discovery turn.

styles.name: 轻盈 Indie-pop
styles.sound: A clean rhythmic guitar/piano motif, a light backbeat and a tuneful restrained refrain.

styles.name: 律动 Funk-pop
styles.sound: A warm bass groove, clean syncopated accents and tight drums support movement and handoffs.

otherGenreRule: The five other styles divide the remaining 39% equally: 7.8% each. If the user changes that pool, preserve the 39% total and divide it equally across the requested pool.
roundingRule: Finite batches use approximate whole-song quotas. Carry accepted-series counts forward; never claim an exact percentage that the actual integer allocation does not achieve.
selectionRule: Choose from the story first, then balance suitable choices across the series. A hybrid counts once under its primary direction.
